manifest.name: Translate
installationSteps: Install the add-on, choose Manual, Automatic, or Both, then review the provider privacy disclosure.
Import the Translate Streamer.bot package and approve its one Translate Text action.
Manual examples: !translate buenos dias, !translate fr hello, !es hello, or a Twitch reply containing !en.
Automatic mode starts allowlist-only and remains bounded by cooldown, percentage, and per-minute limits.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Only bounded cooldown metadata is retained; message text is never stored.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded manual/automatic selection, provider dispatch, and source-platform response routing.
